post.description:
Needs the `password` and, with two-factor on, `code` (authenticator or recovery code); wrong or missing: 422 on the field. Closes
the account at once: profile and vehicles disappear everywhere, QR stickers stop working, every device is signed out, follows
end. Messages stay for the other side as "Gelöschtes Mitglied". Everything is deleted for good within 30 days; there is no way back,
and signing in answers as for an unknown account. Open under every restriction. The same deletion as /konto-loeschen (WEB-05).

post.description:
Needs the current `password` (422 on `password` when wrong) and, with two-factor on, a current `code` (TOTP or recovery code;
missing: 422 `two_factor_code_required`, wrong: 422 on `code`). The same 202 whether or not the new address has an account: a free
address gets a six-digit code, valid 10 minutes; a taken one gets nothing, and its owner is told someone tried. Nothing is sent
during the cooldown of `resend_after_seconds` or above the code budget (5 an hour, 10 a day). 422 on `email` for the current
address.

post.description:
With `device_name` the answer holds a token for that device, replacing its old one. `device_id`, the app's per-install id
(8 to 64 letters, digits and dashes, e.g. a UUID), tells two devices of the same model apart: with it, only the token of that

signed in, which needs GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie first (419 otherwise). Wrong password or unknown address: 401
`invalid_credentials`. Repeated failures: 429 with Retry-After. Suspended: 403 `account_restricted`. New password
needed: 403 `password_change_required`, and a reset code is on its way. An unverified member does get in;
`next_step` says where to resume. An account with two-factor gets `{two_factor_required: true, challenge, expires_in}` instead
of a session or token: send the challenge with a code to POST auth/two-factor/challenge (AUTH-11). A closed account (deletion
requested) answers 401 `invalid_credentials` like a wrong password.

details.description:
By type, language-free. Named details, not data: Laravel (and the export) leave a single resource unwrapped when its
body already has a key "data". followed_published: {kind: "vehicle"|"update", update_id, vehicles, updates} (kind of the latest
event; how many builds were published and updates posted that day). build_saved: {count, week} ("2026-W45"). security:
{event: "new_device"|"password_changed"|"email_changed"|"two_factor_changed"|"deletion_requested"|"sessions_revoked"|"verification_failed"|"recovery_code_used", device_name}.
new_follower: {}. moderation_decision (a decision about the reader's content or account): {decision_id, action:
"remove_content"|"restrict"|"suspend"}. report_decided (the outcome of a case the reader reported): {decision_id, outcome:
"no_action"|"remove_content"|"measures"}, never the measure. SAFE-01 opens the decision.
qr_milestone [SIG]: {milestone: 10|50|100|500|1000}, total scans of the vehicle's stickers; QR-02 opens. hu_au_reminder [SIG]:
{due: "2027-03"}, the month the HU/AU is due; GAR-06 opens. catalog_request (M3.3): {outcome: "accepted"|"rejected", requested:
the make and model the member typed, reason: why it was declined (rejected only), else null}; the vehicle is the member's own.
support_reply (Phase 3): {ticket_id, reference: "SC-7H2KQXMB"}, the team answered that support request; SET-15b opens the
thread. Never the text of the answer.
